correctness.rationale: For coprime odd a>=5,d>=1, parity pairing proves S/2=<a,x,y> with 3x=a+y; reducing triples of x gives normal forms W(u). Strict W(u+a)>W(u) proves the full Apéry set indexed by 0<=u<a. Testing maximal Apéry elements under x,y gives the stated three cases of the complete pseudo-Frobenius set and Frobenius maximum. Verified independently with Dijkstra shortest paths for 1,550 pairs, 2,697,707 exact quotient-membership comparisons, entire Apéry and pseudo-Frobenius sets. Finite checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The 2018 source explicitly raises Frobenius/genus for quotients of initial arithmetic progressions length four through a-1. The inspected 2023 quotient theorem assumes its quotient denominator divides a, whereas here denominator 2 does not divide the odd a. The concrete new contribution is uniform pseudo-Frobenius/type/symmetry plus Frobenius classification in this first nondivisor four-term progression family. Searches for equivalent three-generated semigroup descriptions, direct quotient forms, and relevant records revealed no identical classification. General Apéry machinery is not claimed new. value.rationale: Addresses the first intermediate-length k=3 quotient branch of a published Frobenius-number problem in a regime not covered by divisor-of-a theorems. Exact PF sets classify intrinsic Cohen–Macaulay type and symmetry for every pair of coprime odd parameters, with a sharp offset-dependent Frobenius branch when a≡1 mod3. Structural Apéry and parity reductions provide reusable understanding beyond individual computations; no claim to a full solution for arbitrary k or denominators.
